info.name: GridWise - BUP CSE Fest 2026
info.description: Health check, the 10 official public samples, reworded notes for the LLM, and bad-input cases. Every request has automated checks in its Tests tab that replay the plan against the Problem Statement rules. Change the baseUrl collection variable to switch between local and deployed.
